chunks: I asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
“Then We brought forth such as were therein of the believers; so We found not therein other than one house of the Muslims.”
So Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said: “The family of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم; there did not remain in it anyone other than them.”

key_terms.آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ: the family of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم identified by the Imam as the referent
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the believers mentioned in the Qur’anic verse
key_terms.الْمُسْلِمِينَ: those who submit to Allah, as described in the verse
key_terms.بَيْتٍ: a single household or house singled out in the verse
key_terms.قَوْلِ اللَّهِ: the statement of Allah being asked about for its meaning

ai.seo_question: How does Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام interpret the verse about the believers and the single house of the Muslims?
ai.summary: This hadith presents the verse as referring to آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, identifying them as the true believers and Muslims indicated in the passage. It highlights their singular purity and distinction in the Qur’anic description as explained by Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام.
